question: Should exact target-receipt freshness fail closed already inside WP14, and what identity should preserve durable release validity after unrelated monorepo churn?

wp14_freshness.rule: strict repository_commit must equal checkout HEAD executing WP14
wp14_freshness.effect: Stale-but-internally-coherent target evidence now fails before a green WP14 manifest can be emitted.

workflow.reason_for_self_hosted: Three independent GitHub-hosted PR workflows failed before steps in the observed verification PR, while Hostinger self-hosted is the registered project remote build/test lane.

counterhypothesis_update.finding: Using global git HEAD as the only durable post-release equivalence identity would be overly conservative in a high-churn monorepo because unrelated research/receipt commits can advance HEAD without changing ClayCode build inputs.
counterhypothesis_update.decision: Keep exact-HEAD equality as the contemporaneous collection/WP14/promoter anti-replay invariant. Do not yet use it as the sole long-lived equivalence rule for downstream release reuse.

live_primary_research.mechanism: Explicit action inputs plus content/action hashes support reuse based on actual build inputs.
Source revision plus cryptographic content/material digests are first-class provenance identity.
Content-derived identity can remain stable independent of unrelated external metadata.

architecture_candidate.name: ReleaseInputClosureDigest
architecture_candidate.strongest_risk: An incomplete declared closure can hide a dependency and falsely reuse stale evidence; therefore conservative exact-HEAD remains authoritative until hidden-input falsifiers pass.

remote_lane_cleanup.reason: Self-hosted verification remained queued/unassigned; no remote PASS was claimed and the temporary lane was cleaned to avoid stale duplicate work.

next_falsifiers: Enumerate the complete release-relevant input closure before any durable equivalence implementation.
Unrelated-monorepo-churn differential: global commit changes but closure digest must remain stable.
Release-source/toolchain/dependency mutation differentials: closure digest must change.
Hidden-input mutation: any semantic/artifact change with stable closure digest refutes the candidate closure.
Execute current WP14 + promoter regression on an actually assigned Hostinger lane and later the registered Andreas Ubuntu target before BASE PASS.
